y-m-71-04.topic: Dot product na vectors a jirgin
y-m-71-04.title: Idan aka raba ɓangarorin biyu da a, shin b=c?
y-m-71-04.goal: Nuna da misalin ƙaryatawa cewa dot product daidai ba ya sa vector biyu su yi daidai, sannan ka gano adadin da suka rage idan aka ƙara sharadin girma.
y-m-71-04.material: Vector a jirgi su ne a=(2, 1), c=(1, 3). Jisu ta ce, 'Tun da a·b=a·c, idan aka raba ɓangarorin biyu da a, ana samun b=c.' (Dot alamar dot product ce.) b yana da siffar b=(b1,b2), sassansa kuma lambobi ne na ainihi.
y-m-71-04.thinking.0: Gwada ko ƙa'idar lissafin lambobi za a iya kai tsaye amfani da ita ga dot product na vector.
y-m-71-04.thinking.1: Samar da vector da dama da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-71-04.thinking.2: Yi tunani kan adadin mafita idan an ƙara sharadi.
y-m-71-04.prereq.0: Zato: wannan aiki a matakin babbar sakandare ne, bayan koyon kwas ɗin zaɓi 'Geometry' (sassan conic, vector na jirgi, siffofi masu girma uku da haɗin gwiwar sarari); 'H3' alamar wahala ce kawai ga wannan rukuni, ba warewa ga wani aji ba. Siffar bangaren vector a jirgi, lissafin dot product da sassansa, girman vector.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce mafi tabbaci wajen gwada ko ƙarshen Jisu 'b=c' yana aiki kullum?
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.0: Warware a·b=a·c ta sassa, ka rubuta a matsayin lissafi tsakanin b1 da b2.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi b guda mai cika lissafin, sannan ka kwatanta shi da c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.a: Saka b da yawa, ka duba ko duk suna b=c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.a: Tara misalai da duba waɗanda suka yi daidai kaɗai ba zai tabbatar da 'kullum' ba. Musamman, misalan da ka zaɓa na iya karkata gefe guda.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.b: Tabbatar cewa tunda a ba vector sifili ba ne, za mu iya raba ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar sokewa ta ninkar lambobi kai tsaye ga dot product. Dot product aiki ne da ke mayar da vector zuwa lamba.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.c: Nemo b da a·b=a·c amma b≠c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa domin karya 'kullum', misali guda da ya cika sharadi amma ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne ya isa.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.d: Da farko kwatanta ko girman b da c iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.d: Girma iri ɗaya sharadi ne na zama dole ga b=c, amma da farko duba ko daga sharadin da aka bayar yake biyo baya.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.explain: Domin karya 'yana aiki kullum', misali guda da ya cika sharadi a·b=a·c amma b≠c ya isa.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da b=(b1,b2) 3 mabambanta masu sassansa cikakkun lambobi, inda a·b=a·c amma b≠c. (|b1|≤5.)
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko lissafa a·c ta saka c, sannan ka rubuta a·b ta sassa, ka daidaita su.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi b1, ka duba yadda ake tantance b2, sannan ka tabbatar b ya bambanta da c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a·b ya yi daidai da a·c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a·b bai yi daidai da a·c (=5) ba.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b iri ɗaya ne da c. Nemo wani vector.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.explain: a·c=2·1+1·3=5, saboda haka ya isa 2b1+b2=5. Akwai zaɓuɓɓuka marasa iyaka, kamar (0, 5), (2, 1), (3,−1). Duk irin b ɗin suna da bangaren da ke kan alkiblar a iri ɗaya da c, suna bambanta ne a bangaren da ya tsaya wa a.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.prompt: Idan aka ƙara |b|=|c| (girman b da c daidai ne), b nawa ne gaba ɗaya da a·b=a·c amma b≠c? (Sassan lambobi ne na ainihi.)
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.0: Saka b2=5−2b1 cikin b1²+b2²=10 domin samun magana ta b1.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko c kanta tana cikin mafita da aka samu, sannan ka cire ta.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi zaton b=c kaɗai ne. Warware lissafin biyun tare, ka ƙirga ƙimomin b1 nawa suka fito.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.b: Ka gane cewa sharuddan biyu sun kusan kayyade b. Idan aka warware kai tsaye, akwai wata mafita guda fiye da b=c.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.c: Ka daidaita ta da mafita 2 na lissafin biyun. Ka duba ko ɗaya daga cikinsu ita kanta c ce?
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.d: Ka ɗauko ƙarshen yanayin da sharadi guda ɗaya kawai yake. Tunda akwai wani lissafi ƙari, gano yadda mafita suke sauyawa.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.explain: Haɗa 2b1+b2=5 da b1²+b2²=10 yana ba da (1, 3) da (3,−1). (1, 3) ita ce c kanta, saboda haka b guda ɗaya da ya bambanta da c shi ne (3,−1). Wannan b yana nuna c ta madubi bisa layin alkiblar a.

y-m-71-08.title: Dangane da matsayin maki, tangents nawa za a iya zana?
y-m-71-08.goal: Yi hasashe sannan ka gyara yawan tangents da za a iya zana daga maki da ke wajen, a kan, da kuma cikin parabola y² = 4x; ka bayyana wane tangent ne hanyar warwarewa da ke ɗaukar slope a matsayin harafi take kasa samu.
y-m-71-08.material: Ka yi la’akari da parabola y² = 4x (y a murabba’i daidai yake da 4x). Vertex ɗinta shi ne O(0, 0). Muna son gano yawan layukan tangent da za a iya zana daga maki A a cikin coordinate plane zuwa wannan parabola. Idan maki yana kan parabola, muna ƙirga layin tangent da ya ratsa ta wannan maki. Tsawon layuka ba su da raka’a.
y-m-71-08.thinking.0: Hasashen yawan tangents daga matsayin maki
y-m-71-08.thinking.1: Gyara hukuncinka idan aka bayyana sabon maki
y-m-71-08.thinking.2: Gano yanayin da hanyar warwarewa ta kasa samu
y-m-71-08.prereq.0: Zato: an tsara wannan aiki ne a matakin sakandare babba, domin a warware shi bayan an riga an koyi kwas ɗin zaɓi na “Geometry” (conic sections, vectors a fili, da solid geometry da coordinates a sarari); “H3” alamar wahala ce kawai ta wannan rukunin samarwa, ba yana nufin an ware kwas ɗin ga wani takamaiman aji ba. Siffar ma’auni ta parabola, lissafin tangent (tangent mai slope m yana da siffar y = mx + 1/m), discriminant na lissafin quadratic
y-m-71-08.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana maki ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, ka yi hasashen yawan tangents da za a iya zana daga wannan maki.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saka coordinates na maki cikin y² = 4x, sannan ka kwatanta wanne ne ya fi girma: y² ko 4x.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta tangent mai slope m a matsayin y = mx + 1/m, saka coordinates na maki domin samun lissafi a cikin m, sannan ka duba alamar discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tangents nawa za a iya zana daga A zuwa parabola?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Tangent y = mx + 1/m da ya ratsa A(1, 3) yana cika 3 = m + 1/m, wato m² − 3m + 1 = 0; discriminant ɗinsa 5 ne, tabbatacce, saboda haka akwai slopes biyu. Makin yana wajen parabola, don haka akwai tangents 2.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi tunanin tangent ɗaya ne kawai. Ka gwada ko za ka iya nemo slopes biyu dabam-dabam na tangents da ke ratsa maki.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ba ka bambanta ko maki yana wajen parabola ko a cikinta ba. Ka yi tunanin daga wane gefe ne za a iya zana tangents.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka tuna cewa daga maki na wajen parabola akwai tangents biyu; wannan ya dace da kwatanta matsayin maki.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.info: A wannan karon, maki B(1, 2) ne.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Tangents nawa za a iya zana daga B?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Tangent da ya ratsa B(1, 2) yana cika 2 = m + 1/m, wato (m − 1)² = 0, saboda haka slope guda ɗaya ne kawai (m = 1). Daga maki da ke kan parabola akwai tangent 1.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi hukunci cewa daga maki da ke kan parabola akwai tangent guda ɗaya kawai, wato tangent ɗin da ya ratsa wannan maki.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka ɗauko ƙarshen hukunci na maki na waje zuwa nan. Wannan maki yana kan parabola, saboda haka matsayinsa ya sauya.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Daga maki a kan parabola akwai layin tangent a wurin. Duba ko akwai tangent da ya ratsa maki.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tangent nawa za a iya zana daga C?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Tangent da ya ratsa C(4, 1) yana cika 1=4m+1/m, wato 4m²−m+1=0; discriminant 1−16<0, saboda haka babu gangara. Ba za a iya zana tangent daga maki na ciki ba.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka ɗauko ƙarshen hukunci na maki da ke kan parabola. Wannan maki ba ya kan parabola.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka yanke cewa maki yana cikin parabola, saboda haka babu tangent ko ɗaya.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ɗauko ƙarshen hukunci na maki na waje. Kwatanta girman 4x da y² domin duba ko maki na ciki ne.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.reflect: Adadin tangent a maki ukun su ne 2, 1, da 0. Ta yaya za ka bayyana matsayin maki ta kwatanta girman y² da 4x? Ka kuma yi tunanin alaƙar wannan kwatancin da alamar discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.prompt: Tangent nawa za a iya zana ga parabola daga maki D(0, 3)? Nemo ka rubuta duk layukan tangent, sannan ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai da sakamakon mafitar da ta ɗauki gangara m.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta yadda lissafin a·m²−b·m+1=0 na m yake sauyawa idan haɗin gwiwar x na D ta zama 0.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙirga yawan tangent da ka samo daga maganar m, sannan ka zana layuka da dama ta D a alkiblu mabambanta domin duba ko akwai wasu layuka da suka haɗu da parabola a maki guda kawai.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Na bayyana da kalmomi yadda lissafin mafitar da ta saita gangara a matsayin m yake sauyawa?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Na bambanta tangent mai gangara da tangent wanda ba za a yi amfani da gangararsa ba?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Na duba cewa tangent ɗin da na rubuta da gaske yana ratsa D(0, 3)?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.0: 2. Saka (0, 3) cikin y=mx+1 yana ba da 3=1/m, saboda haka tangent guda y=x/3+3 mai gangara 1/3 ne kawai ya fito; amma axis y (x=0), wanda ba shi da gangara, shi ma tangent ne a ƙarshen parabola, don haka jimillar 2 ce.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.1: Tangent biyu ne. Wannan yana yiwuwa domin D yana wajen parabola; ɗaya x=0 ne, ɗaya kuma y=(1/3)x+3. Ba za a iya rubuta x=0 a siffar y=mx+n ba, saboda haka mafitar da ta yi amfani da gangara ta rasa shi.

y-m-71-01.title: Shin wuri guda ne kawai ke tazarar 10 daga focus?
y-m-71-01.goal: A mafitar neman maki bisa tazara daga wuri a parabola zuwa focus, nemo layin da ya manta symmetry, sannan ka ƙididdige yawan wuraren da suka cika sharadin.
y-m-71-01.material: Yi la’akari da parabola y²=8x a coordinate plane. F shi ne focus, P(x,y) wuri ne a parabola. Ɗalibi ya nemo duk P mai PF=10 kamar haka. Raka’o’in coordinates iri ɗaya ne, ba a rubuta raka’ar tsawo.
y-m-71-01.thinking.1: Ƙididdige yawan wuraren da suka cika sharadi
y-m-71-01.thinking.2: Tantance ko mafita tana samuwa daga zangon ƙimomi
y-m-71-01.prereq.0: Zato: an tsara wannan aiki ga matakin sakandare mai zurfi, bayan an koyi Geometry (conic sections, vectors na fili, jikuna da coordinates na sarari); “H3” alamar wahalar samarwa ce kawai, ba sanya shi ga ajin ba. Ma’anar parabola da focus/directrix na y²=4px da lissafin tazara tsakanin maki.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko marar daidai a mafita.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.0: Saka bayanin kowanne layi cikin layi na gaba kai tsaye, ka kwatanta ko yawan yanayi ya ragu daga layin baya zuwa na gaba.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta duk ƙimomin y da za a samu idan x=8 a cikin lissafin parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.0: Daga y²=4px, 4p=8, saboda haka p=2, focus F=(2,0), directrix kuma x=−2. (2, 0)
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.1: Ga P(x,y) a parabola, PF daidai yake da tazarar P zuwa directrix, saboda haka PF=x+2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.2: PF=10, don haka x+2=10, wato x=8.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.3: y²=8×8=64, don haka y=8, kuma P(8,8) ne kaɗai ya cika sharadin. (8, 8)
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka P mai PF=10 shi ne (8,8). (8, 8)
y-m-71-01.s.s1.explain: Layi 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne. A layi na 4, idan y²=64, to y=8 ko −8. Parabola tana da symmetry game da axis x, saboda haka maki (8,8) da (8,−8) duka sun cika sharadin. Layi na 5 ya ɗauko mantuwar layi na 4. (8, 8)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da maki P(x,y) daban-daban 2 masu integer coordinates a parabola da PF=10. (F=(2,0).) (2, 0)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta dangantakar x da y a matsayin lissafi bisa sharadin wuri yana kan parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi x, duba ko y integer ne, sannan ka lissafta tazara zuwa F kai tsaye.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Wurin ba ya kan parabola y²=8x.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Tazarar zuwa F(2, 0) ba 10 ba ce.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.explain: Maki kaɗai da suka cika sharuddan biyu su ne (8, 8) da (8,−8). x ƙima guda ce tabbatacciya, y kuma tana da yiwuwar alama biyu kawai.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.prompt: Maki P nawa ne a wannan parabola da PF=1?
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta PF a matsayin magana ta x, sannan ka duba zangon ƙimomin x da maki a parabola zai iya samu.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.1: Lissafa kai tsaye tazarar daga ƙarshen O(0, 0) zuwa F.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.a: Ɗaya. Ƙarshen O irin wannan maki ne.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.a: Idan ka lissafa PF a ƙarshen kai tsaye, ba 1 ba ce. Ka yi hasashen mafi kusa ba tare da lissafi ba.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.b: Biyu. Maki biyu masu fuska da juna bisa axis x.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka ci gaba da sakamakon matakin baya cewa 'maki biyu masu fuska da juna' yadda yake. Dole ne da farko a duba ko ƙimar x mai yiwuwa ce.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.c: Ba za a sani ba. Ba za a iya yanke hukunci daga siffa kawai ba.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.c: Maganar PF=x+2 tana ba ka damar tantance zangon ƙimomin yiwuwa. Wannan ba rashin bayani ba ne.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.d: x+2 yana zama 2 a mafi ƙaramin ƙimar x da zai iya ɗauka. Wannan hukunci ya bincika zangon tazarar da za a iya samu.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.explain: PF=x+2, a parabola kuma x≥0, don haka PF≥2. Domin PF=1, sai x=−1, amma y²=−8, babu y na ainihi. Sharadin tazara zai iya rasa mafita gaba ɗaya.

y-m-71-02.title: Shin maki da jimillar tazara zuwa maki biyu take tsayayye kullum ellipse ne?
y-m-71-02.topic: Ma'anar ellipse (jimillar tazara zuwa maki biyu)
y-m-71-02.goal: Nemo sharadin da ake buƙata domin saitin maki da jimillar tazara zuwa maki biyu take tsayayye ya zama ellipse, sannan ka faɗi siffar da ake samu idan sharadin ya gaza ko yana kan iyaka.
y-m-71-02.material: A jirgin haɗin gwiwa akwai maki F(−4, 0) da F′(4, 0) (karanta F da F prime). Tazarar maki biyun 8 ce. Maki P(x,y) yana motsi ta yadda PF+PF′=s. A nan s ƙima ce tabbatacciya mai kyau, kuma an rubuta tazara ba tare da ma'auni ba.
y-m-71-02.thinking.0: Gano sharadin da ke ɓoye a ma'anar.
y-m-71-02.thinking.2: Yi tunani kan siffa a yanayin iyaka.
y-m-71-02.prereq.0: Zato: an saita wannan aiki a matakin babbar sakandare, a warware bayan an riga an koyi zaɓin 'Geometry' (sassan conic, vector na jirgi, siffofi masu girma uku da haɗin gwiwar sarari); 'H3' alamar wahala ce kawai ga wannan rukuni, ba yana nufin an ware kwas ɗin ga wani aji ba. Ma'anar da daidaitacciyar siffar ellipse, tazara tsakanin maki biyu, dangantaka tsakanin tsawon ɓangarori uku na alwatika.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.prompt: Ba tare da sanin ƙimar s ba, za mu iya cewa maki P ke zana ellipse?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka wasu ƙimomin s, ka duba ko irin wannan P yana samuwa ko a'a.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta dangantakar da ke tsakanin tsawon ɓangarori uku idan aka haɗa P, F, F′ su zama alwatika.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.a: Ba za mu iya cewa ba. Idan s=8 ko ƙasa, ba ellipse ba ne.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka nuna cewa baya ga ma'anar, dole ne a kwatanta s da tazarar maki biyun.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.b: Za mu iya cewa. Matukar jimilla ta tsaya, kullum ellipse ne.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka tuna ma'anar har zuwa 'jimilla tana tsayayye' kawai. Ka taɓa kwatanta girman jimillar da tazarar maki biyun?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.c: Ba za mu iya cewa ba. Matsayin maki biyun kawai ne ke kayyade shi.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.c: s ƙima ce tsayayyiya, tana shafar siffa. Gwada abin da ke sauyawa idan ka sauya s.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.d: Za mu iya cewa. Ko wace ƙima tabbatacciya s ce, P yana samuwa.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka ɗauki 'P yana samuwa' da 'siffar ellipse ce' a matsayin abu ɗaya. Ko da P yana samuwa, siffar ba dole ellipse ba ce.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′≥FF′=8; saboda haka idan s<8 babu irin wannan P, idan s=8 kuma maki suna kan sashin FF′. Ellipse ne kawai idan s>8. Saboda haka ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da s.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.prompt: Idan s=10, shigar da maki P(x,y) 2 mabambanta masu haɗin gwiwa cikakku da suka cika PF+PF′=10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da zaɓen maki a kan axis, ka lissafa PF da PF′ ga kowanne.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.1: Idan jimillar tazarori biyun na maki da ka zaɓa ta fi 10, matsar da maki kusa da focus biyun; idan ta ƙasa, matsar da shi nesa.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Jimillar tazara zuwa maki biyun 10 ce.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Jimillar tazara zuwa maki biyun ba 10 ba ce.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.explain: Maki kaɗai masu haɗin gwiwa cikakku su ne guda huɗun (5, 0), (−5, 0), (0, 3) da (0,−3). Farawa da axis yana ba ka damar tara tazarori kai tsaye. Akwai maki da yawa a ellipse da ba cikakkun lambobi ba.

y-m-71-03.title: Idan ya haɗu a maki guda kawai, shin tangent ne?
y-m-71-03.topic: Haɗuwar hyperbola da layi, layukan tangent.
y-m-71-03.goal: Nemo da kanka yanayin da faɗaɗawar 'layin da ya haɗu a maki guda tangent ne' ke rushewa ga hyperbola, sannan ka bayyana dalilin ta hanyar danganta shi da asymptote.
y-m-71-03.material: Yi la'akari da hyperbola H: x²/9−y²/16=1 (karanta x murabba'i bisa 9 a cire y murabba'i bisa 16 daidai 1). Asymptote na H su ne y=(4/3)x da y=−(4/3)x. Ana rubuta layuka da px+qy=r (p,q,r cikakkun lambobi ne, kuma p da q ba 0 duka ba). Wani ɗalibi ya ce, 'Ga ellipse, layin da ya haɗu da ita a maki guda tangent ne. Don haka ga H ma, layin da ya haɗu a maki guda dole tangent ne.'
y-m-71-03.thinking.0: Gano sharuddan misalin ƙaryatawa ga faɗaɗa iƙirari.
y-m-71-03.thinking.2: Bayyana bambanci tsakanin tangent da layin da ya haɗu a maki guda.
y-m-71-03.prereq.0: Zato: wannan aiki a matakin babbar sakandare ne, bayan koyon kwas ɗin zaɓi 'Geometry' (sassan conic, vector na jirgi, siffofi masu girma uku da haɗin gwiwar sarari); 'H3' alamar wahala ce kawai ga wannan rukunin samarwa, ba warewa ga aji ba. Daidaitacciyar siffa da asymptote na hyperbola, ma'anar discriminant idan an haɗa layi da conic.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.prompt: Wane irin layi ya kamata ka nema domin gwada ko maganar ɗalibin tana aiki kullum ga H?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta iƙirarin ta raba zuwa 'idan sharadi A, to ƙarshe B'. Menene A da B?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko iƙirarin zai rushe da misali guda kawai.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.a: Wani layi da ya haɗu da H a maki biyu dabam.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.a: Iƙirarin yana magana ne kan layukan da suka haɗu 'a maki guda kawai'. Layi da ya haɗu a maki biyu ba cikin abin da iƙirarin ya shafa ba ne.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.b: Layin da ba tangent ba wanda ya haɗu da H a maki guda kawai.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka nemi layi da ya cika sharadi na farko 'ya haɗu a maki guda' amma ya karya sharadi na biyu 'tangent ne'.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.c: Duk wani layin tangent na H.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.c: Tangent da ya haɗu a maki guda misali ne da ya yarda da iƙirarin. Tattara ƙarin irin waɗannan misalai ba zai nuna cewa iƙirarin ƙarya ba ne.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.d: Wani layi da ba ya taɓa H ko kaɗan.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.d: Layin da ba ya taɓa H bai cika sharadin iƙirarin na haɗuwa a maki guda ba tun da farko.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.explain: Domin nuna cewa 'idan A to B' ƙarya ne, ana buƙatar misalin da ya cika A amma bai cika B ba. A nan A shi ne 'ya haɗu a maki guda kawai', B kuma 'tangent ne'.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.prompt: Daga layukan px+qy=r, shigar da layuka 2 mabambanta da suka haɗu da H a maki guda daidai amma ba tangent ba. (|p|, |q|≤20, |r|≤100. Ana ɗaukar layi ɗaya da aka rubuta da cikakkun lambobi masu daidaiton rabon a matsayin layi guda.)
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta layin a matsayin y=mx+k, saka shi cikin lissafin H; lissafa ko akwai m da ke sa ƙimar x² a maganar x ta zama 0.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta irin wannan m da gangarar asymptote na H, sannan ka rubuta gangarar a matsayin rabon p da q domin p da q su zama cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan p da q duka 0 ne, ba layi ba ne.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Riƙe p da q aƙalla 20, r kuma aƙalla 100 a cikakkiyar ƙima.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Layi ne da ke haɗuwa a maki guda kawai (sharadin gangara).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Wannan layi ba irin wanda yake haɗuwa a maki guda ba ne (ko kuma tangent ne).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Ba ya ratsa asali, saboda haka ainihin yana haɗuwa da H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Idan r=0 ne, asymptote kanta ce kuma ba ta haɗuwa da H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.explain: Misali: 4x+3y=6 yana haɗuwa da H a maki guda amma ba tangent ba ne. Dalili kuwa gangarar layin nan iri ɗaya ce da ta asymptote y=−(4/3)x. 5x+3y=9 ko x=3 suna haɗuwa a wuri guda kuma tangent ne, saboda haka ba misalan ƙaryatawa ba ne.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana cikin jimloli 2 zuwa 3 dalilin da ya sa layin da ka zaɓa ba tangent ba ne ko da yake ya haɗu da H a maki guda, ta amfani da lissafin layinka ko asymptote da gangara.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta jimla guda da ke nuna wace ƙima a lissafin layinka ta yi daidai da ta asymptote.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙara layi ɗaya kan yadda digirin maganar x ke sauyawa.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Bayani na ya ƙunshi lissafi ko gangarar layin da na zaɓa?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na bambanta da kalmomina cewa 'ya haɗu a maki guda' da 'tangent ne' ba abu ɗaya ba ne?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na yi tunanin yadda lissafin tsarin biyu zai bambanta da a ce tangent ne?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.0: Layin 4x+3y=6 yana da gangara iri ɗaya da asymptote y=−(4/3)x, saboda haka suna layi ɗaya. Idan aka saka shi, ƙimar x² ta ɓace, ya zama lissafi madaidaici mai mafita guda, don haka yana haɗuwa a maki guda; amma ba lissafi quadratic mai tushen ninki biyu ba ne, don haka ba tangent ba ne.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.1: Layin da yake layi ɗaya da asymptote yana haɗuwa da H a wuri guda, amma ya bambanta da tangent mai discriminant 0. Tangent yana haɗuwa da H a wurin taɓawa ya tsaya a gefe ɗaya na lanƙwasa; wannan layin kuwa yana ketare reshen hyperbola.

y-m-71-06.title: Maki nawa ne suka cika sharadin tazara iri ɗaya?
y-m-71-06.topic: Tazara daga wuri zuwa axis da fili a space coordinates
y-m-71-06.goal: Bambance tazara zuwa axis da zuwa coordinate plane a space coordinates, sannan tsara maki da suka cika sharuɗɗan tazara biyun tare.
y-m-71-06.material: A space coordinates, axes x,y,z suna perpendicular, xy-plane kuma z=0 ne. Akwai P(3, 4, 12). “Tazara zuwa coordinate axis” ita ce tsawon perpendicular daga wuri zuwa axis; “tazara zuwa coordinate plane” ita ce tsawon perpendicular zuwa plane. Ba a rubuta raka’o’in tsawo ba.
y-m-71-06.thinking.0: Bambance tazara zuwa axis da tazara zuwa plane
y-m-71-06.thinking.1: Tsara maki da suka cika sharuɗɗa biyu lokaci guda
y-m-71-06.thinking.2: Bayyana dangantakar adadin sharudda da degrees of freedom
y-m-71-06.prereq.0: Zato: aikin matakin sakandare mai zurfi ne bayan an koyi Geometry (conic sections, vectors na fili, jikuna da space coordinates); H3 alamar wahala ce kawai. Space coordinates, tazara tsakanin maki biyu, ma’anar axes da coordinate planes.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.prompt: Menene tazara daga P(3, 4, 12) zuwa axis z?
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta coordinates na wuri a axis z da ke da z-coordinate iri ɗaya da P.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta component ɗin da bambanci tsakanin wannan wuri da P ya fito.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da cewa wuri mafi kusa a axis z shi ne (0, 0, 12), ka samo tazara daga components x da y kawai.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta z-coordinate kai tsaye. Wannan yana da alaƙa da tazara zuwa xy-plane.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka samo tazara zuwa asali. Asali ba shi ne wuri mafi kusa a axis ba.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka haɗa x da y kawai. Tazara tsawon perpendicular ce, don haka a yi amfani da ka’idar Pythagoras.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.explain: Wuri mafi kusa da P a axis z shi ne (0, 0, 12), tazarar kuma √(3²+4²)=5. z-coordinate 12 shi ne tazara zuwa xy-plane.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da maki Q(x,y,z) integer coordinates daban-daban 4 masu tazara 5 zuwa axis z da tazara 12 zuwa xy-plane.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta expression na x,y da ke ba tazara 5 zuwa axis z, nemo integer pairs da dama da suka cika.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ƙimomin z nawa ne suka cika tazara 12 zuwa xy-plane.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Tazara zuwa axis z ita ce 5.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Tazara zuwa axis z ba 5 ba ce.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Tazara zuwa xy-plane ba 12 ba ce.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.explain: Integer pairs 12 ne ke cika x²+y²=25, z kuma 12 ko −12 ne, saboda haka maki 24 masu integer coordinates gaba ɗaya ne. Sharuddan biyu suna shafar coordinates daban.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.prompt: Ta amfani da maki da ka ƙirƙira, bayyana dalilin da ya sa maki da yawa ke cika sharuɗɗan biyu ko da sharudda biyu ne kawai. Bayyana yadda ake zaɓar x,y dabam da z.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta saitin maki x²+y²=25 yake wakilta a xy-plane.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta adadin ƙimomin z da sharadinsa ke yarda da su.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dabam sharadin da ke tantance x,y da wanda ke tantance z?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka haɗa aƙalla coordinate guda na misalinka?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunanin yawan maki idan coordinates ba sai integer ba?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan tazara zuwa axis z ta zama 5, x²+y²=25, don haka a xy-plane maki suna kan da’irar radius 5. Akwai da yawa kamar (3, 4) ko (4,−3); sharadin tazara 12 zuwa xy-plane yana ba z=12 ko −12, yanayi biyu, saboda haka maki suna ninkuwa.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.model.1: Dole ne a ƙayyade x,y,z guda uku amma sharudda biyu ne kawai: jimillar x²+y² da absolute value na z. Saboda haka wurin na iya motsi. Baya ga 3²+4²=25, akwai 5²+0²=25, z kuma 12 ko −12, don haka maki 24 daban.

y-m-71-05.title: Idan zangon coefficients ya sauya, wace siffa maki zai zana?
y-m-71-05.topic: Haɗin vector a jirgi da siffofi.
y-m-71-05.goal: Yi hasashen cewa siffar da P ke zana tana sauyawa bisa sharuddan coefficients x da y a OP=x·OA+y·OB; tabbatar cewa yankin yana zama lebur idan vector biyun layi ɗaya ne; sannan ka ƙirƙiri maki da suka cika sharadin yanki.
y-m-71-05.material: A ce O asalin jirgin haɗin gwiwa ne, ka rubuta matsayin maki P da vector OP=x·OA+y·OB (karanta: vector OP daidai yake x ninka vector OA da y ninka vector OB). x da y lambobi ne na ainihi, sharuddan kuma suna sauyawa a kowane mataki. An rubuta tsawo ba tare da ma'auni ba.
y-m-71-05.thinking.0: Sake hasashen siffa yayin da sharudda suke sauyawa.
y-m-71-05.thinking.1: Yi tunani kan yadda layi ɗayantar vector biyun ke shafar yankin.
y-m-71-05.prereq.0: Zato: wannan aiki a matakin babbar sakandare ne, bayan koyon kwas ɗin zaɓi 'Geometry' (sassan conic, vector a jirgi, siffofi masu girma uku da haɗin gwiwar sarari); 'H3' alamar wahala ce kawai ga wannan rukuni, ba warewa ga aji ba. Siffar bangaren vector a jirgi, ninkawa da ƙari na scalar, layin da ya ratsa maki biyu, yankin parallelogram.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana sharudda da maki mataki-mataki. A kowane mataki, yi hasashen siffa (ko yanki) da P ke zana.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, zaɓi nau'i-nau'i biyu ko uku na (x,y) da suka cika sharuddan, sannan ka lissafa haɗin gwiwar P kai tsaye.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.1: A mataki na 3, kwatanta sassan domin gano dangantakar OA da OB.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.info: A(2, 0), B(0, 2), kuma x da y lambobi ne na ainihi da ke cika x+y=1.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.after: P=(2x, 2y) kuma x+y=1, saboda haka maki suna kan layi x+y=2. x da y na iya zama marasa kyau, don haka duk layin AB ne.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka haɗa da yiwuwar x da y su zama marasa kyau.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi la’akari da x,y≥0 kawai. Sharadin bai takaita alamu ba.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: x+y=1 daidaito guda ne, ba zai cika faɗin yanki ba. Tantance yawan degrees of freedom da ya bari.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ƙara sharadi ga A da B iri ɗaya: x+y=1, x≥0, y≥0.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu wace siffa ce P ke zana?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Wuri x=2,y=−1 ya fita domin ya saɓa wa y≥0. Ragowar maki suna da x,y aƙalla 0 da jimilla 1, wato sashen AB. Ya dace a taƙaita hasashen baya bisa sabon sharadi.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ba ka bincika maki da sabon sharadin ya cire ba. Idan x=2, y nawa ne?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yanke cewa coefficients marasa kyau kaɗai suka rage, don haka sashen tsakanin A da B ne kawai.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Gwada ko maki masu x tsakanin 0 da 1 sun cika sharadin.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Canza vectors zuwa A(2, 1) da B(4, 2), sharadin kuma 0≤x≤1 da 0≤y≤1 ne. (Babu sharadin x+y=1.)
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Menene faɗin yankin da P ke motsi a ciki?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.after: OB=2·OA, saboda haka P=(x+2y)·OA. x+2y yana tsakanin 0 da 3, don haka yankin sashen daga asali zuwa (6, 3) ne, faɗinsa 0. Idan vectors parallel ne, parallelogram ɗin ya zama shimfiɗe.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka lura B=2A ne, don haka vectors biyun alkibla ɗaya suke.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ɗauka rectangle ne kuma vectors perpendicular ne. Ba ka duba kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu ba.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 4 (ninkin first components 2 da second components 2 na vectors)
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ninka wasu components kaɗan kawai. Faɗin parallelogram yana dogara da alkiblar gefuna.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.reflect: Daga mataki 1 zuwa 2 da 2 zuwa 3, me ya canza siffar? Bayyana dabam canjin sharadin coefficients da canjin vectors.
y-m-71-05.s.s2.prompt: OA=(3, 0), B=(b1,b2) yana da integer coordinates. Shigar da maki B daban-daban 3 inda parallelogram na P=x·OA+y·OB, 0≤x≤1, 0≤y≤1, faɗinsa daidai 6 ne. (|b1|≤5)
y-m-71-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta faɗin parallelogram da OA da OB suka kafa ta ɗaukar OA a matsayin tushe da nemo tsawo.
y-m-71-05.s.s2.hint.1: Matsar da B zuwa wurare biyu ko uku, duba ko faɗi yana canzawa idan b1 ya canza.
y-m-71-05.s.s2.explain: Tushen OA tsawonsa 3 ne, tsawon tsawo kuma |b2| ne, don haka faɗi 3|b2| ne. Idan 3|b2|=6, b2=2 ko −2, b1 kuma zai iya zama komai; akwai amsoshi da yawa.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.prompt: A s2, me ya sa faɗi ba ya canzawa duk integer b1 da ka zaɓa?
y-m-71-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ɗauki OA a matsayin tushe, lura da tsawo yayin B ke zamewa ta alkiblar axis x.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta canjin tsawo idan b2 ya canza.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.o.a: Yayin b1 ke girma, parallelogram ya fi karkata kuma faɗi ya ragu
y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.a: Ka kalli karkata kawai ba tare da tushe da tsawo ba. Dukansu na iya kasancewa ɗaya ko da karkatar ta canza.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.o.b: Faɗi ya dogara ne da tsawon OB kawai, don haka idan b1 ya ƙaru faɗi ma ya ƙaru
y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka yanke faɗi bisa tsawon gefe ɗaya. Ka rasa cewa kusurwar gefunan biyu ma tana canzawa.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.o.c: Faɗi ya dogara da kusurwar da ke tsakanin vectors kawai, ba shi da alaƙa da b1
y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.c: Ka ɗauka kusurwa iri ɗaya yana nufin faɗi iri ɗaya. Tsawon gefuna ma yana shiga lissafin.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.o.d: Tushen OA iri ɗaya ne, tsawo kuma girman y-coordinate na B ne ke ƙayyade shi.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.d: Ka fahimci component ɗin da ke ƙayyade faɗi ta tushe da tsawon.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.explain: OA yana kan axis x, saboda haka tushe 3 ne, tsawon kuma tazarar B zuwa axis x, |b2|, ce. Canza b1 yana matsar da B parallel da axis x, tsawo bai canza ba.

y-m-71-07.material: A space coordinates, xy-plane α shi ne z=0. m1 axis x ne da direction vector (1, 0, 0); m2 layi ta (0, 1, 0), parallel da axis x, da vector (2, 0, 0). Duka suna cikin α. y-m-71-07.prereq.0: Zato: aikin sakandare mai zurfi ne bayan an koyi Geometry (conic sections, plane vectors, solids da space coordinates); H3 alamar wahala ce kawai. Components da dot product na vectors a space coordinates, perpendicularity/parallelism na layuka, da ma’anar perpendicularity da plane.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin mafitar ɗalibin da hujjarsa ba ta wadatar.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta lissafin layi na 2 da na 3 gefe da gefe ka kwatanta ko bayanai daban ne.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko d=(0, 1, 0) yana cika layi na 2 da 3, kuma ko layin perpendicular ne ga α.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.0: A ɗauki vector ɗin alkiblar layi l ya zama d = (d1, d2, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.1: Ya perpendicular da vector ɗin alkibla (1, 0, 0) na m1, saboda haka d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.2: Haka kuma ya perpendicular da vector ɗin alkibla (2, 0, 0) na m2, saboda haka 2 · d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.3: Idan layi ya perpendicular da layuka biyu a cikin wani fili, to ya perpendicular da wannan filin; saboda haka l ⟂ α.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka d dole ya kasance a siffar (0, 0, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 da na 3 daidai ne, amma layi na 3 lissafi iri ɗaya ne da na layi na 2 (d1 = 0). Layi na 4 ya faɗi magana ba tare da sharadinta ba; wannan yana aiki ne kawai idan layukan biyu da ke cikin filin ba su kasance parallel ba. Don haka layi na 5 ma ba tabbatacce ba ne.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da vector ɗin alkibla guda 3 masu integer components, masu alkibla dabam-dabam, na layuka l waɗanda d yake perpendicular da vector ɗin alkiblar m1 da m2, amma l ba perpendicular da α ba. (|d2|, |d3| ≤ 5. Ana ƙirga alkibla iri ɗaya sau ɗaya.)
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta sharuɗɗan perpendicularity da m1 da m2 a matsayin lissafi na components, sannan ka duba wane component na d aka ƙayyade.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta dangantakar da d yake buƙatar samu da (0, 0, 1) domin ya perpendicular da α, sannan ka zaɓi components da suka karya wannan dangantaka.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Ya perpendicular da m1 da m2.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Ba ya perpendicular da vector ɗin alkibla (1, 0, 0) na m1.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ba ya parallel da normal ɗin alkibla (0, 0, 1) na α.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan d yana da siffar (0, 0, d3), to ya perpendicular da α, saboda haka ba misalin da ke karya ƙa’ida ba ne.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Ka kiyaye |d2| da |d3| kada su wuce 5.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.explain: d = (0, 1, 0), (0, 1, 1), da (0, 1, 2) duk suna da d1 = 0, saboda haka suna perpendicular da m1 da m2; amma ba su parallel da (0, 0, 1) ba, don haka ba su perpendicular da α. Tun da m1 da m2 parallel ne, an yi amfani da bayani iri ɗaya sau biyu.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.prompt: Domin a kammala cewa l ⟂ α, wane bayani ne ya kamata a ƙara wa bayanin da ke sama?
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowanne zaɓi, rubuta ko yana kawo sabon lissafi game da components na d.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sabon lissafin yana ba da bayani iri ɗaya da d1 = 0 ko kuma wani bayani dabam.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.a: Haka kuma ya perpendicular da wani layi a cikin α wanda yake parallel da axis ɗin x
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.a: Layi mai alkibla iri ɗaya da ta m1 da m2 ba ya samar da sabon lissafi. Ka kwatanta ko yana ɗauke da bayani iri ɗaya da na layukan biyun da suka gabata.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.b: l yana wucewa ta wani maki da ke wajen α
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.b: Matsayin maki ba ya sauya lissafin vector ɗin alkibla. Ana buƙatar bayani game da alkibla, ba game da maki da layin yake wucewa ba.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.c: Haka kuma ya perpendicular da wani layi a cikin α wanda ba ya parallel da axis ɗin x
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.c: Ka fahimci cewa ana buƙatar bayani game da wani layi mai alkibla dabam a cikin filin. Layuka biyu marasa parallel a cikin fili ɗaya suna haɗuwa a maki guda.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.d: l yana haɗuwa da m1 a maki guda
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.d: Samun maki inda layuka suka haɗu bayani ne game da matsayi. Ba ya samar da sabon lissafi game da alkibla.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.explain: Idan layi ya perpendicular da layuka biyu marasa parallel a cikin fili, to ya perpendicular da filin. Misali, idan ya kuma perpendicular da alkiblar axis ɗin y (0, 1, 0), to d2 = 0 kuma d = (0, 0, d3).

y-m-71-09.title: Idan aka nuna inuwa, shin yanki yana zama ninkin cosθ ko ninkin cos²θ?
y-m-71-09.goal: Gwada ɗaya daga cikin samfura biyu da lambobi ga siffa takamaimai, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa 'duk ɓangarori suna raguwa' ba daidai ba ne ta hanyar bambanta ɓangarorin da suke layi ɗaya da layin haɗuwar jiragen da waɗanda suke tsaye masa.
y-m-71-09.material: A sararin haɗin gwiwa, alwatika ABC yana da kusurwoyi A(0, 0, 0), B(4, 0, 0), C(0, 4, 4). Kusurwar θ tsakanin jirgin alwatikan da jirgin xy ita ce 45°, cos45°≈0.707. Inuwar alwatikan da aka jefa a tsaye kan jirgin xy tana da kusurwoyi A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C′(0, 4). Jihu ya ce, 'Tsawo yana raguwa ninkin cosθ, don haka faɗi da tsawo duka suna raguwa, yankin kuma ya zama ninkin cos²θ,' Seoa kuma ta ce, 'Yankin yana zama ninkin cosθ.' An cire ma'aunin tsawo.
y-m-71-09.thinking.1: Nemo raunin da ke cikin hujjar da aka bayar.
y-m-71-09.thinking.2: Bayyana ta hanyar haɗa sauyin ɓangarori da na yanki.
y-m-71-09.prereq.0: Zato: wannan aiki a matakin babbar sakandare ne, bayan koyon kwas ɗin zaɓi 'Geometry' (sassan conic, vector na jirgi, siffofi masu girma uku da haɗin gwiwar sarari); 'H3' alamar wahala ce kawai ga wannan rukunin samarwa kuma ba yana nufin an ware kwas ɗin ga wani aji ba. Haɗin gwiwar sarari, kusurwa tsakanin jirage biyu, ma'anar tsinkayar tsaye da asali ra'ayoyin tsayin tsinkaya da yankinsa.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.prompt: Yankin alwatika ABC shi ne 8√2≈11.31, yankin tsinkayar kuma 8. Mene ne wannan misali guda zai gaya mana game da iƙirarin biyun?
y-m-71-09.s.s1.hint.0: Saka θ=45° cikin dabarun iƙirarin biyu, sannan ka yi hasashen yankin tsinkaya ga kowanne.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya ƙimomin hasashen biyun gefe da gefe da ainihin yankin tsinkaya, 8.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.a: Ninkin cos²θ na Jihu ne daidai. Domin 0.707 ita ce cos²45°.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.a: cos²45°=0.5 ce. Ba ka bincika da lissafi wace dabarar 0.707 take wakilta ba.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.b: Ya yi daidai da ninkin cosθ na Seoa. Misali guda ba hujja ba ne, saboda haka zan duba wasu siffofi ma.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.b: Ka tabbatar ya yi daidai da samfurin Seoa, kuma ka yi la'akari da iyakar misali guda.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.c: Iƙirarin biyun ba daidai ba ne. Domin 0.707 ya bambanta da cos45°.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka duba daga bayanan cewa cos45° kusan 0.707 ce ba.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.o.d: Ya yi daidai da ninkin cosθ na Seoa, ya saɓa wa ninkin cos²θ na Jihu.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya samo asali ne daga lissafin ƙimomin hasashen samfuran biyu da kwatanta su da ainihin ƙima.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.explain: Ainihin rabo 8÷8√2≈0.707 ya yi daidai da cos45°≈0.707, ya bambanta da cos²45°=0.5. Wannan misali guda ya yarda da samfurin Seoa, amma misali guda ba zai tabbatar da aiki ga kowace siffa ba.
y-m-71-09.s.s1.acc.0: Ya yarda da samfurin Seoa, kuma an ƙara taka-tsantsan cewa a duba wasu siffofi domin misali guda ne kawai. Wannan amsar ana karɓarta a nan.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.prompt: Ga wata sabuwar siffa. Murabba'i PQRS yana da kusurwoyi P(0, 0, 0), Q(2, 0, 0), R(2, 3, 3), S(0, 3, 3). Gefe PQ tsawonsa 2 ne kuma bayan tsinkaya har yanzu 2 ne. Gefe QR tsawonsa 3√2 ne, bayan tsinkaya kuma 3. Ta yaya za ka tantance hujjar Jihu 'duk tsawo suna raguwa ninkin cosθ' ga wannan siffa?
y-m-71-09.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafa dabam rabon tsayin da aka tsinkaya zuwa na asali ga PQ da QR.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko ninka rabon biyun daidai yake da rabon yankunan.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.a: Ba ya aiki. Akwai gefe da tsawonsa bai sauya ba.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.a: Ka gano daga bayanai cewa tsawon gefe yana raguwa gwargwadon alkiblarsa.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.b: Yana aiki. PQ da QR duka suna raguwa idan aka yi tsinkaya.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.b: Ba ka duba yadda tsawon PQ ke sauyawa ba. Ya tsaya 2 zuwa 2.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.c: Ba ya aiki. Bayan tsinkaya, duk gefuna a zahiri sun fi tsawo.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.c: Babu gefe da ya fi tsawo. Kwatanta tsawon asali da na tsinkaya ga kowane gefe.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.o.d: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba. Murabba'i ne, ya bambanta da alwatika na baya.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.r.d: Ko da sunan siffar ya bambanta, za ka iya kwatanta tsawon gefe. Wannan yanayin ne bayanin ya isa a yanke hukunci.
y-m-71-09.s.s2.explain: PQ yana layi ɗaya da layin haɗuwar jiragen (axis x), saboda haka tsawonsa yana nan, QR kaɗai ne ke raguwa ninkin cosθ (3√2→3). Don haka hujjar 'duk gefuna sun zama cosθ ninki' ba daidai ba ce. Yankin yana sauyawa daga 6√2 zuwa 6, kusan ninkin 0.707, daidai da raguwa a alkibla guda kawai.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.prompt: Ta yaya za ka bayyana wa Jihu? Ta amfani da siffofin biyun da ke sama, rubuta da lambobi yadda tsawon gefe ya sauya da dalilin da ya sa yanki yake ninkin cosθ, ba cos²θ ba.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta a tebur tsawon PQ da QR kafin da bayan tsinkaya.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.hint.1: Daga teburin, rubuta jimla ɗaya kan alkiblar da ke raguwa da wadda take nan yadda take.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Na rubuta da kalmomina cewa alkibla ɗaya tana nan yadda take, ɗaya kaɗai ne ke raguwa?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Lambobin da na rubuta (misali 8√2→8, 6√2→6, 2→2, 3√2→3) sun yi daidai da bayanin da ke sama?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Na kwatanta rabon yankin da zai samu idan alkiblu biyun sun ragu?
y-m-71-09.s.s3.model.0: Alkibla mai layi ɗaya da layin haɗuwar jiragen, kamar PQ, tana riƙe tsawonta idan aka yi tsinkaya, alkibla da ta tsaya mata ce kaɗai ke zama ninkin cosθ. Saboda haka yankin ninkin cosθ ne, ba cos²θ ba. A misalin nan ma 6√2 ya zama 6, kusan ninkin 0.7.
y-m-71-09.s.s3.model.1: Gefe PQ bai sauya daga 2 zuwa 2 ba. Gefe QR kaɗai ne ya ragu daga 3√2 zuwa 3, don haka rabon shi ne 1/√2. Da dukkan gefuna sun ragu, rabon ya kamata 1/2 ne, amma ainihin rabon yanki 6/(6√2) ne, kusan 0.7, saboda haka bai yi daidai ba.
